achievements.name: Wolffort Stands
achievements.detail: Win General Avlora's Assault and hold Castle Wolffort.

achievements.name: Scales Tipped
achievements.detail: Place your votes on the Scales of Conviction to settle a party decision.

achievements.name: Conviction Recruit
achievements.detail: Recruit an ally who joins only after your convictions meet that character's terms.

achievements.name: Follow-Up
achievements.detail: Trigger a follow-up attack from an ally beside the enemy you strike.

achievements.name: Quietus Used
achievements.detail: Use a Quietus bought from the Sundry Shop during a battle.

achievements.name: Class Promoted
achievements.detail: Promote a unit with a medal from the Sundry Shop.

achievements.name: Smithy Upgrade
achievements.detail: Pay the encampment smithy to upgrade a unit's weapon.

achievements.name: Mock Battle
achievements.detail: Win a Mental Mock Battle from the tavern in the encampment.

achievements.name: Kudos Spent
achievements.detail: Earn kudos in battle, then spend them at the encampment Sundry Shop.

achievements.name: No Losses
achievements.detail: Finish a story battle without any allied unit being defeated.

achievements.name: Exploration Find
achievements.detail: Pick up an item during an exploration break between battles.

achievements.name: Route Finished
achievements.detail: Clear the final chapter on the story path you are following.
